title: Thrombocytopoiesis and Platelet Homeostasis in Infants With Bronchoplumonary Dysplasia
brief_summary: To investigate the relationship between bronchopulmonary dysplasia and thrombocytopenia.
study_population: Bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) is one of the common complications in neonatal intensive care units (NICU), mainly occurs in premature infants and is considered to be the main cause of premature death
